payload.task_text:
I am an HR analyst and I need to prepare a workforce education analysis report for our leadership team. We have an HR data warehouse that contains employee records across all departments, and I need you to analyze the education level distribution.

Please query the employee data from the HR analytics system to understand the education breakdown by department. I need to know how many employees hold each level of education in each department and what percentage of each department that represents.

Create an Excel file called Education_Analysis.xlsx in the workspace with two sheets. The first sheet should be named "By Department" and have the following columns: Department, Total_Employees, Bachelors_Count, Masters_Count, PhD_Count, Bachelors_Pct (rounded to 1 decimal place), Masters_Pct (rounded to 1 decimal place), and PhD_Pct (rounded to 1 decimal place). Sort the rows alphabetically by Department.

The second sheet should be named "Summary" and have two columns, Metric and Value, with the following rows: Total_Employees (total headcount across all departments), Most_Common_Education (the education level with the highest count overall), Department_Highest_PhD_Pct (the department name with the highest percentage of PhD holders), Avg_Salary_PhD (average salary for PhD holders, rounded to 0 decimal places), and Avg_Salary_Bachelors (average salary for employees with a bachelor's degree, rounded to 0 decimal places).

Additionally, create a page in Notion titled "Workforce Education Analysis" that summarizes the key findings. Include a heading for each department followed by a paragraph noting that department's total headcount and PhD percentage. At the end, add a paragraph highlighting which department has the highest proportion of PhD holders and what the overall most common education level is across the company.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent. Dispatching sub-agents is not necessary. Run the compact education and department aggregates, freeze one verified analysis, then create Education_Analysis.xlsx and the required knowledge-base page with native parallel tool calls in the same response and reconcile both against the same rows.

Create an Excel workbook for an HR workforce education analysis.

## Deliverable
File path (exact): /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_GLM-5.3-Flash/SingleUserTurn-sf-hr-education-notion/workspace/Education_Analysis.xlsx

The workbook must contain exactly two sheets, in this order:

### Sheet 1 — name exactly "By Department"
Row 1 is a bold header row with these exact column names:
Department | Total_Employees | Bachelors_Count | Masters_Count | PhD_Count | Bachelors_Pct | Masters_Pct | PhD_Pct

Then these 7 data rows (already sorted alphabetically by Department). All values are numbers (percentages are already rounded to 1 decimal place — write them as numeric values, NOT strings, NOT formulas, do not re-round):

| Department | Total_Employees | Bachelors_Count | Masters_Count | PhD_Count | Bachelors_Pct | Masters_Pct | PhD_Pct |
| Engineering | 7096 | 3182 | 1321 | 125 | 44.8 | 18.6 | 1.8 |
| Finance | 7148 | 3240 | 1259 | 133 | 45.3 | 17.6 | 1.9 |
| HR | 7077 | 3156 | 1288 | 150 | 44.6 | 18.2 | 2.1 |
| Operations | 7120 | 3214 | 1269 | 141 | 45.1 | 17.8 | 2.0 |
| R&D | 7083 | 3191 | 1244 | 147 | 45.1 | 17.6 | 2.1 |
| Sales | 7232 | 3370 | 1327 | 117 | 46.6 | 18.3 | 1.6 |
| Support | 7244 | 3280 | 1308 | 146 | 45.3 | 18.1 | 2.0 |

### Sheet 2 — name exactly "Summary"
Row 1 is a bold header row with two columns: Metric | Value
Then these 5 data rows, in this exact order:
| Metric | Value |
| Total_Employees | 50000 |
| Most_Common_Education | Bachelor's |
| Department_Highest_PhD_Pct | HR |
| Avg_Salary_PhD | 57920 |
| Avg_Salary_Bachelors | 58387 |

Values in the Value column should be numeric where they are numbers (50000, 57920, 58387 as integers; "Bachelor's" and "HR" as text).

## Requirements
- Create the directory if needed (it exists: /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_GLM-5.3-Flash/SingleUserTurn-sf-hr-education-notion/workspace).
- Default sheet(s) created by the workbook tool that are not one of the two required sheets must be removed, so the workbook ends up with exactly two sheets named "By Department" and "Summary".
- Bold the header rows. Column widths wide enough to display all content.
- Percentages: store as plain numbers like 44.8 (not 0.448, no percent formatting).
- After writing, read back both sheets and verify: sheet names, header names, row order, and every cell value match the tables above exactly.

## Return contract
Report back: the final file path, the list of sheet names in order, and confirmation that all cell values were verified against the tables above (mention any discrepancy immediately if one occurs).
Build Education_Analysis.xlsx

Create a page in Notion summarizing an HR workforce education analysis. This data was pulled from an HR data warehouse (HR_ANALYTICS database, EMPLOYEES table, 50,000 employees across 7 departments).

## Deliverable
A Notion page with the exact title: "Workforce Education Analysis"

Create it as a top-level page in the workspace (search first with a title query for "Workforce Education Analysis" to make sure a page with this exact title does not already exist; if one exists, update/replace its content rather than duplicating).

## Page content structure (in this exact order)
1. An intro paragraph: "This report summarizes the education level distribution of our workforce across all departments, based on 50,000 employee records from the HR analytics warehouse."
2. For EACH of the 7 departments below, in this exact order: one heading (use heading_2) with just the department name, followed by one paragraph directly beneath it. The paragraph must state the department's total headcount and its PhD percentage. Use this exact text pattern for each paragraph:

- Heading: "Engineering" → Paragraph: "Engineering has a total headcount of 7,096 employees. PhD holders make up 1.8% of the department."
- Heading: "Finance" → Paragraph: "Finance has a total headcount of 7,148 employees. PhD holders make up 1.9% of the department."
- Heading: "HR" → Paragraph: "HR has a total headcount of 7,077 employees. PhD holders make up 2.1% of the department."
- Heading: "Operations" → Paragraph: "Operations has a total headcount of 7,120 employees. PhD holders make up 2.0% of the department."
- Heading: "R&D" → Paragraph: "R&D has a total headcount of 7,083 employees. PhD holders make up 2.1% of the department."
- Heading: "Sales" → Paragraph: "Sales has a total headcount of 7,232 employees. PhD holders make up 1.6% of the department."
- Heading: "Support" → Paragraph: "Support has a total headcount of 7,244 employees. PhD holders make up 2.0% of the department."

3. A final paragraph at the end of the page (after all 7 department sections) with these two key findings: "HR has the highest proportion of PhD holders of any department, at 2.1% of its workforce. Across the entire company, the most common education level is Bachelor's, held by 22,633 of 50,000 employees (45.3%)."

## Notes
- Use Notion blocks: heading_2 for department headings, paragraph blocks for text. All blocks must be appended to the new page in the order listed above.
- The percentages shown are rounded to 1 decimal place; use them exactly as given.
- After creating, verify the page title and that all 8 headings/paragraph sections appear in order by reading back the page's block children.

## Return contract
Report back: the Notion page ID, the page URL, and confirmation that the title and all content blocks were verified in order (flag any discrepancy immediately).
Create Notion analysis page
